norm: tsyncfvmexception is thrown when errors of the tsyncfvmerrordomain are reported in exception contexts instead of via ara core errorcode
assumption: TsyncFvmException is thrown when errors of the TsyncFvmErrorDomain are reported in exception contexts instead of via ara::core::ErrorCode.
rationale: The class is declared in the payload as an exception class of the FVM, whereas functional error handling is based on ErrorCode.
